name: web-hotel-search-and-recommend-crop-with-feature-chips
title: Hotel Search Crop with Feature Chips
whatItIs: A cropped lavender page of a phone showing hotel search fields and a Recommend card with a 25% OFF torn sticker over a villa photo, a room photo, three pill chips (Nearby, Top Rated, Best Value) with icons and a paragraph, above a centred phone showing the same screen.
whatItMeans: Torn sticker and icon chips add friendly details to a clean form, and cropping suggests a longer scroll.
techniques: Torn-edge discount sticker on a photo

vocabulary.definition: A label with rough torn edges placed over a photo.
A pill with an icon naming a benefit.
A page fragment cut at the edges.
